traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Gymnosperms (DELTA, 2008 onwards, version of 5 August 2019), Podocarpaceae: evergreen trees and shrubs; leaves relatively broad and flat, or linear, or scale-like; mostly spiral, decussate in Microcachrys; dioecious, rarely monoecious. Mabberley (2017) agrees: usually dioecious, leaves in spirals, linear to scale-like, and narrow and flat in Podocarpus.
